name: DPM++ SDE noise term
plain: The 2M and 3M SDE samplers compute the noise term from the half-logSNR step, not from an ancestral split, and it scales with eta. The plain dpmpp_sde sampler is different: it uses an ancestral split in lambda space.
math:
With h=λ(σ_next)−λ(σ), λ=half-logSNR (non-flow: h=log(σ/σ_next); flow: λ=−logit σ), x ← … + ε·σ_next·√(1−exp(−2hη))·s_noise·noise_scale, if η>0 and s_noise>0.
ε = BrownianTree by default.
label: from code

audit.note: sampling.py:921-922,937: h is the half-logSNR step λ_next−λ, which equals log(σ/σ_next) only for non-flow models; CONST uses −logit(σ) (sampling.py:154-157). sampling.py:844-849: sample_dpmpp_sde does use get_ancestral_step (in λ space), so the plain claim does not hold for the whole sde family.
